NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: To show you on the map, only while you use the app. Your location is rounded to about 500 m and never stored.
NSCameraUsageDescription: To take the day-after photos you share with your followers.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To pick the day-after photos you share with your followers.
NSContactsUsageDescription: Optional: to find friends already on RightPlace. We only send hashed phone numbers, never names or numbers.
